newsitem.title: USA: Aetrium wins quad test site handler order.
newsitem.headline: Aetrium wins quad test site handler order.

text.p: Aetrium Inc said Thursday it received orders totaling nearly $2 million for its quad test site handler that was introduced last July.
The company said the product, used by semiconductor manufacturers to test computer chips, will be shipped to a single unidentified customer by the end of the year.
The product can test up to four integrated circuits at a time and can process up to 14,000 chips of various sizes per hour, Aetrium said.
Aetrium designs and supplies proprietary technologies and equipment used to make and test integrated circuits.
Its shares closed off 3/8 Thursday at 15-1/8.
